# Playtrace

> Discover games shared on r/aigamedev, follow their development, and share public feedback and an optional ideal price.

- [Browse Playtrace](https://playtrace.neorgon.com/): Search games by genre, stage, maker, and recent activity.
- [About the index](https://playtrace.neorgon.com/about.html): Collection history, source limits, feedback, and corrections.
- [Current catalogue](https://playtrace-api.neorgon.workers.dev/api/v1/catalog): Paginated public JSON with source-linked timelines, collection dates, and available Steam metadata. Follow pagination.nextCursor until null.
- [Service status](https://playtrace-api.neorgon.workers.dev/api/v1/status): Available features and the latest archive collection state.
- [Source community](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/): Original game posts and author updates.

Browsing and contributing feedback require no account. A note, optional display name, and optional ideal price are public. A browser edit key allows editing or removal from the same browser. Ideal prices are nonbinding USD suggestions. Browser and network rate limits reduce spam; contribution counts do not establish unique people. Visitor change requests go to a private admin inbox. Private following remains unavailable while account setup is completed.

The catalogue combines reviewed entries with source-described archive discoveries. Being listed does not verify a creator or a game's availability. Source dates, original posts, and review status accompany entries. Preview images remain at their source unless a creator permits managed storage.

- [Neorgon](https://neorgon.com/): More tools in the suite.
